  qp=np.array(o['proprio']['joint_pos']);g=np.array(o['imu']['gravity']);w=np.array(o['imu']['gyro']);q=np.zeros(19);q[[3,8]]=.6

 return poly[np.argsort(np.arctan2(*(poly-poly.mean(0))[:,::-1].T))]
